6.104 rsInvalidScopeInMatrix
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsInvalidScopeInMatrix is a critical error that will occur when a RunningValue, RowNumber, or
Previous aggregate function within a Matrix does not contain as its Scope parameter a string constant
that is equal to the name of a containing group in the Matrix.
